messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
The viscous friction force depends on the angular velocity, the damping coefficient, and the fluid properties.
properties such as viscosity, density, and surface area set the damping coefficient for a physical pendulum.
pendulum models should include viscous friction when motion occurs in a fluid and the damping is not negligible.
negligible viscous effects may be ignored in an ideal undamped pendulum, while significant effects require a damped equation.
